nodes.label: Prediction Result Page Mockup (Safe)
nodes.description: UI mockup of the SEMD (Suspicious-URL Evaluation for Malicious Detection) web app's prediction result screen for the benign/safe classification state. Shows a browser-chrome frame with the SEMD top nav (report dashboard, flag report, URL check, API access, knowledge base, GitHub, sample_user profile icons). Below is a result card showing: analysis timestamp (2025/09/28 | 09:00), the analyzed URL (http://www.paulharneygolfcourse.homestead.com/), the prediction label 'ปลอดภัย' (Safe) in green text, a confidence percentage of 99.98%, a recommendations section with safety tips (verify the source destination is legitimate, avoid entering personal info on non-HTTPS sites), and a QR code in the bottom-right of the card. Two action buttons sit below the card: 'หน้าหลัก' (Home/Back) and 'แชร์ผลลัพธ์' (Share Result, blue button).
